# The shared machinery of the #249 and #257 programmes, copied verbatim from the paper repository
# (`plectis-erdos`, `lean/Erdos249257`), where it is the library every downstream file imports. The
# corpus used to carry its own copy of it under the `Erdos257PeriodNoncollapse` prefix; that prefix
# now holds generated compatibility shims over this library, so the corpus carries the mathematics
# once. The glob makes every module a build target, which is what lets the port be admitted in
# dependency-ordered slices. Deliberately not a default target: CI's target list is unchanged.
[[lean_lib]]
name = "Erdos249257"
globs = ["Erdos249257.*"]

[[lean_lib]]
name = "Erdos257PeriodNoncollapse"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "ErdosProblems"
# The launch root plus the 21 Sep source-port aggregator. The aggregator is a second root so the
# ported paper-bound source modules resolve as a build target without widening the launch closure;
# it is deliberately not a default target, so CI's target list is unchanged.
globs = ["ErdosProblems", "ErdosProblems.SourcePort20260921"]
